description: This file contains functions for detecting dangerous command substitutions, prefix matching for command validation, and decision logic for auto-approving or denying commands based on allowlist and denylist patterns, including handling complex command chains.

methods.name: containsDangerousSubstitution
methods.description: Detects dangerous parameter substitutions in a command string that could lead to command execution, such as parameter expansions, indirect references, here-strings, process substitutions, and glob qualifiers.

methods.name: findLongestPrefixMatch
methods.description: Finds the longest prefix from a list of command patterns that matches the start of a given command, case-insensitive, with special handling for wildcards.

methods.name: isAutoApprovedSingleCommand
methods.description: Determines if a command should be auto-approved based on allowlist and denylist, considering wildcard allowlist and prefix length comparisons.

methods.name: isAutoDeniedSingleCommand
methods.description: Determines if a command should be auto-denied based on denylist and allowlist, using prefix length comparisons.

methods.name: getCommandDecision
methods.description: Analyzes a full command string, including chained commands, to decide whether to auto-approve, auto-deny, or ask the user, based on allowlist, denylist, and detection of dangerous substitutions.

methods.name: getSingleCommandDecision
methods.description: Decides whether a single command should be auto-approved or denied by comparing the longest matching prefixes in allowlist and denylist.
